Seer.trigger: Witch claims Seer is a wolf based on a save
Seer.rationale_short: when the Witch claimed you were a wolf, you should have focused the village on the factual contradiction: the Witch claimed to save you, yet you were still alive and active

Seer.trigger: Pressure to rely on behavioral analysis
Seer.rationale_short: Use your data as the only objective metric and ignore 'vibes'

Guard.trigger: Seer is alive and there are other confirmed villagers
Guard.rationale_short: Never stop protecting the Seer until they are the only confirmed villager left

Witch.trigger: Knowledge of a player's role is not confirmed by save potion

Villager.trigger: Seer provides a 'Clear' for a player
Villager.rationale_short: When the Seer provides a 'Clear,' that player is an absolute truth

Villager.trigger: Player attempts to frame a Seer-cleared player
Villager.rationale_short: any attempt to frame a cleared player is a wolf signal
When the Seer clears someone, you must vote as a unified block against anyone attacking that cleared player

Villager.trigger: Wolves claim Seer alignment is 'wolf coordination'
Villager.rationale_short: Agreeing with the Seer is not 'wolf coordination'—it is village alignment

Villager.trigger: Seer's data is questioned based on erratic behavior
Villager.rationale_short: Do not let wolves gaslight you into doubting the Seer's data based on 'erratic behavior'
